interpretation.key_result: Measured channel bed at Muçum is several metres below gauge zero; airborne/drone terrain cannot represent the submerged thalweg.
interpretation.s09_use: Use SGB LST as the authoritative channel-section evidence for S09 once the plotted profile is digitized or original numeric LST file is recovered.
interpretation.current_limit: The article exposes the surveyed profile graph and key extrema, but the complete station-distance/elevation vertices have not yet been recovered as a numeric table.
interpretation.vertical_reference: Gauge-relative stage datum. Do not merge numerically with MDT elevations until RN/nivelamento/gauge-zero elevation is reconciled.
interpretation.cross_section_network_note: SGB material provides gauge-section LSTs plus measurement sections ~0.7–1.0 km upstream, useful for local channel-geometry constraints around S09.
